provenance.statement: These are AI-generated images produced with the Codex built-in image_gen tool for this project, not photographs of real businesses. They depict no real business, person, brand or place. The masters in public/art/generated/ are the source of truth.

photos.subject: A dim shop counter with a worn worktop, scale and shelves of stock.
A worker packing goods at a back-room workbench beside a laptop.
A cafe bar with an espresso machine, glassware and a worker.
A small barber reception with a chair, desk, magazines and grooming tools.
A metalworking bench covered with hand tools beneath a workshop lamp.
A calm, evenly lit interior with no focal point, used as a washed-back section ground.
